steps.description: Retrieve the list of stock tickers to be compared
Fetch trading data for each stock ticker including price history
Calculate the minimum trading value for each stock from the fetched data
Compute price differences between the stocks based on their trading data
Compile and compare the tickers, minimum values, and price differences into a summary report
